description: Defines the StringType class and related objects for handling string data types with collation and constraints in Apache Spark SQL.

classes.name: StringType
classes.description: Represents string data type with collation and constraints, supporting binary and case-insensitive operations.

classes.name: IndeterminateStringType
classes.description: Represents a string type resulting from coercing two different non-explicit collations.

classes.name: StringConstraint
classes.description: Trait for string constraints such as fixed length or maximum length.

classes.name: NoConstraint
classes.description: Object representing no constraint on string length.

classes.name: FixedLength
classes.description: Constraint specifying a fixed length for strings.

classes.name: MaxLength
classes.description: Constraint specifying a maximum length for strings.

methods.name: supportsBinaryEquality
methods.description: Checks if binary equality is supported based on collation.

methods.name: supportsLowercaseEquality
methods.description: Checks if lowercase equality is supported.

methods.name: isCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Checks if collation is case-insensitive.

methods.name: isAccentInsensitive
methods.description: Checks if collation is accent-insensitive.

methods.name: usesTrimCollation
methods.description: Checks if collation supports space trimming.

methods.name: isUTF8BinaryCollation
methods.description: Checks if collation is UTF8 binary.

methods.name: isUTF8LcaseCollation
methods.description: Checks if collation is UTF8 lowercase.

methods.name: supportsBinaryOrdering
methods.description: Checks if binary ordering is supported.

methods.name: typeName
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the type, including collation info.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string describing the StringType instance.

methods.name: collationName
methods.description: Returns the name of the collation.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on collationId and constraint.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on collationId.

methods.name: defaultSize
methods.description: Returns default size of string type (20 bytes).

methods.name: asNullable
methods.description: Returns a nullable version of StringType.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Creates StringType from collation name or ID.

methods.name: tryCompare
methods.description: Compares two StringConstraints.

methods.name: lteq
methods.description: Checks if one StringConstraint is less than or equal to another.

methods.name: gteq
methods.description: Checks if one StringConstraint is greater than or equal to another.

methods.name: equiv
methods.description: Checks if two StringConstraints are equivalent.

methods.name: isPlainString
methods.description: Checks if StringType has no constraints.

methods.name: isMoreConstrained
methods.description: Checks if one StringType has more constraints than another.

methods.name: tightestCommonString
methods.description: Finds the tightest common StringType between two StringTypes.

methods.name: removeCollation
methods.description: Removes collation info from a StringType, returning a basic CharType or VarcharType.
